1. (Currently amended) A method of providing advertisements in a traffic message comprising: - obtaining traffic data having a traffic condition of a location description on a road network using a processor-based system; - assessing a location reference code associated with the location description assigned by a traffic message supplier using the processor-based system; - assessing an advertising reference code associated with the location reference code using the processor-based system; - determining whether the advertising reference code is present using the processor-based system; and - generating a traffic message having the location reference code and the advertising reference code when the advertising reference code is present using the processor-based system, wherein the traffic message is transmitted to a navigation device.
